sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Claim_Headers"."Policy_ID" AS e, AVG((CAST(("Claim_Headers"."Amount_Claimed" - "Claim_Headers"."Amount_Piad") AS REAL) / "Claim_Headers"."Amount_Piad")) AS m1 FROM "Claim_Headers" GROUP BY "Claim_Headers"."Policy_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10

why: (amount claimed - amount paid on claim) / amount paid on claim: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
